plain: In 1978, Lieutenant Colonel Jesse Marcel, an officer who handled the 1947 crash debris at Roswell, New Mexico, is said to have come forward and called the official weather balloon explanation "just a cover story." Michels tells this himself several times. He adds that Marcel said he was forced to pose for a photo with balloon material. In another telling Michels dates it to 1979 and says Marcel claimed to have handled "memory metal," a metal that springs back to its shape. Bob Lazar, a well-known figure in UFO circles, passes on Marcel's point that the material in the press photos taken under General Roger Ramey "wasn't the stuff that we found." If true, it would mean the military swapped out the real wreckage to hide what it had recovered.
